recent_posts.title: Use Google Play Instant To Handle Deep Links — A Real World Scenario
recent_posts.summary: The Volvo Cars App now supports co-driving invitations through deep links, allowing users to share their driving experience with others. Implementing this involved overcoming challenges such as handling authentication and installation processes without the app being pre-installed. Google Play Instant was leveraged to provide a seamless user experience, guiding those without the app through sign-up and installation while preserving deep link context. The post details how to create an instant app via different approaches, specifically focusing on modularization and effective use of product flavors, ensuring a smooth entry point for new users.

recent_posts.title: Volvo Cars’ First Open Source In-Car App Simplifies Life for Diabetes Patients
recent_posts.summary: Volvo Cars has launched its first open-source in-car app to assist diabetes patients by integrating continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems with the car's Android Automotive system. This innovation aims to enhance safety by providing real-time glucose level updates and allowing drivers to take necessary actions, like finding parking or nearby convenience stores, through seamless navigation integration. The app is open source, encouraging third-party developers to build similar in-car applications.

recent_posts.title: Agnostic Build System: Powertrain build
recent_posts.summary: Volvo Cars has released the Powertrain build project, an agnostic build system for embedded software development. It offers easy movement between different targets, enables Software in the Loop testing, and streamlines continuous integration processes. The build system is written in Python and includes options for different builds. It works harmoniously with the Zuul CI system and is designed to improve codebase integrity and developer feedback. The project is open source, aiming to fill industry gaps and foster collaboration among OEMs.

recent_posts.title: How to share test cases across organizations and companies
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to share test cases across organizations and companies using Coppercomm, a Python library that serves as a bridge between the host and DUT for different communication interfaces. Open sourcing Coppercomm allows for collaboration and bug fixing across multiple companies.

recent_posts.title: How we are driving up the quality of internal technical documentation at Volvo Cars
recent_posts.summary: Learn how Volvo Cars is improving the quality of internal technical documentation with a small team of technical writers, by treating docs like code, leveraging industry best practices, defining doc quality criteria, having an empathetic approach with developers, establishing documentation feedback loops, and working to change the documentation culture.

recent_posts.title: What could quantum computing do for Automotive Companies?
recent_posts.summary: Quantum computing has the potential to assist automotive companies in various ways, including addressing optimization problems, improving machine learning with large datasets, and optimizing EV battery chemistry. However, the technology is still in its early stages, with limitations related to qubit availability and programming challenges.
